what: Plan §6.3 calibration row: a 12 m/s T-bone into a door detaches that door (P1-S04a). Car 0 is parked facing +z; car 1 drives +x at 12 m/s from 0.5 m away into its right-hand side, its flat nose spanning the seam between the two doors. The nose's two corners take the load, and the rear door takes the main blow: it detaches. The front door beside it and the front wheel (both clipped by the other corner) lose some health and stay intact; the T-boning car's own front takes a loose-grade hit; nothing else changes.
